name: Temporal Change Detection in Mitotic Spindles
description:
Quantify dynamic structural changes in the 'Mitosis' sample image. Open the 'Mitosis (26MB, 5D stack)' sample. Isolate the Green channel (spindles) and perform a Maximum Intensity Z-Projection to create a 2D time-series. Extract the first frame (start) and the last frame (end) as separate images. Use the Image Calculator to create an absolute difference map between the start and end frames. Finally, threshold this difference map (Otsu method) and measure the Area of the changed regions.

Save the following to ~/ImageJ_Data/results/:
1. 'spindle_start.tif' (The Z-projected first frame)
2. 'spindle_end.tif' (The Z-projected last frame)
3. 'change_map.tif' (The result of the difference calculation)
4. 'change_quantification.csv' (Results table containing the measured Area)
